data.title: 1 Bedroom Apartment
data.summary: Neat one bedroom flat with kitchen cabinets and a wardrobe, in a small block where the landlord lives on site.
data.address_line: Kinondoni Shamba, a few minutes from Kinondoni Road
data.description:
A clean, quiet one bedroom apartment on the first floor of a small block in Kinondoni Shamba. It has an open sitting area, kitchen cabinets with space for a gas cooker, and a built-in wardrobe. Curtains and a sofa set are left in place.

The landlord lives on the compound and keeps the building tidy, with a storage tank so water does not run out. Suitable for a single professional or a couple. Available from the date shown, viewings can be arranged before then.
data.water_details: DAWASA mains with a storage tank

data.title: Modern 2 Bedroom Apartment
data.summary: Bright third-floor flat with a balcony, water tank and covered parking, five minutes from Old Bagamoyo Road.
data.address_line: Mikocheni B, off Old Bagamoyo Road, near Regent Estate
data.description:
A bright, well-kept 2 bedroom apartment on the third floor of a quiet block in Mikocheni B. The sitting room opens onto a balcony with a good sea breeze, and both bedrooms have built-in wardrobes and ceiling fans. The kitchen is fitted with cabinets and has space for a gas cooker.

The block has a security guard at the gate, one covered parking space per flat and a water tank with a booster pump, so water is steady even when the mains are off. Viewing is by appointment, any day between 9am and 6pm.
data.water_details: DAWASA mains with a 5,000 L storage tank and pump

data.title: 2 Bedroom Apartment with Lake Views
data.summary: Apartment on the Capri Point hillside with balconies looking out over Lake Victoria.
data.description:
A modern two bedroom apartment in a low-rise block on the Capri Point hillside. Both bedrooms are en-suite and open onto shaded balconies with views towards Lake Victoria. The kitchen is fitted, and curtains and wardrobes are included.

The building has a security guard, off-street parking and a generator for the corridors and water pump during power cuts. The lakeshore, restaurants and Mwanza city centre are a short drive away.
data.water_details: MWAUWASA mains with a rooftop tank
data.power_details: Own prepaid LUKU meter; generator for common areas

data.title: Affordable Family House
data.summary: Detached 3 bedroom house in a walled compound with a garden, a short walk from schools and Sinza market.
data.address_line: Sinza Mori, 300 m off Sam Nujoma Road
data.description:
A detached family home on its own walled plot in Sinza Mori. Three bedrooms (the master is en-suite), a large sitting and dining room, and a separate kitchen with room for a gas cooker and a fridge. Floors are tiled throughout and the bedrooms have wardrobes.

The compound has a lockable steel gate, parking for two cars and a small garden where children can play. The landlord is easy to reach and prefers a family tenant on a long-term lease.
data.water_details: DAWASA mains with an overhead tank

data.title: Modern 3 Bedroom Bungalow
data.summary: Single-storey bungalow with a paved driveway and lawn in a quiet Njiro street.
data.description:
A modern single-storey bungalow with three bedrooms, two bathrooms and an open kitchen and sitting area. The house sits in a fenced plot with a wide paved driveway and a small lawn. Arusha’s cool evenings mean you will rarely need a fan.

Njiro is one of Arusha’s most popular residential areas, with supermarkets, schools and restaurants nearby, and easy access to the town centre. Security lights are fitted around the house.
data.water_details: AUWSA mains with a storage tank

data.title: 3 Bedroom Family Home
data.summary: Spacious family home on a large plot with a garden, covered veranda and servant quarter, in a green part of Kibada.
data.address_line: Kibada, 10 minutes from the Kigamboni ferry
data.description:
A modern three bedroom home on a generous plot in Kibada. Two bedrooms are en-suite and the open-plan sitting and dining room gets good cross-ventilation. There is a covered veranda at the front, a landscaped garden, and a separate servant quarter with its own toilet at the back of the compound.

Water comes from a borehole into a large storage tank, so supply is steady. The area is quiet and green; the ferry and the Nyerere (Kigamboni) Bridge both give access to the city centre. The agent asks for six months upfront.
data.water_details: Borehole with a 10,000 L storage tank

data.title: Affordable Studio
data.summary: Compact furnished studio with a kitchenette, a short walk from the Ubungo BRT and bus terminals.
data.description:
A tidy, fully furnished studio with a bed, wardrobe, work desk and a kitchenette with a two-plate gas cooker. Suits a student, intern or young professional who wants to keep costs low and stay close to transport.

Water is included in the rent. Electricity is on a prepaid LUKU sub-meter so you only pay for what you use. Ubungo bus terminal, the BRT (mwendokasi) stop and many daladala routes are a short walk away, and there are food vendors and shops on the same street.
data.water_details: Water included in rent (tank on site)

data.title: Furnished Self-contained Room
data.summary: Furnished room with its own bathroom, popular with students and first-time renters near Mwenge.
data.address_line: Mwenge, 5 minutes from the Mwenge bus stand
data.description:
A comfortable self-contained room with a bed, study desk and wardrobe, plus a private bathroom. Ideal for a student or someone starting their first job. Wi-Fi can be shared with the landlord for a small monthly contribution.

The room is in a fenced compound with other tenants. Mwenge bus stand, markets and food stalls are a short walk away, and daladala to Kariakoo and the city centre run all day.
data.power_details: Shared LUKU meter, bills split monthly

data.title: Spacious 4 Bedroom Family House
data.summary: Two-storey house with a steel gate and veranda in a big fenced compound, good for large or extended families.
data.description:
A well-built two-storey house on a large fenced plot with a steel gate and a shaded veranda. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms, a big sitting room and a separate dining room. The kitchen is spacious with a pantry cupboard, and the compound has mature palms and space for a kitchen garden.

Mwananyamala hospital, several schools and Bagamoyo Road daladala stops are all close by. Available in five days once the landlord finishes repainting.
data.water_details: DAWASA mains with two storage tanks

data.title: Garden House near Stone Town
data.summary: Two bedroom house with high ceilings, a shaded garden and a veranda, a walk from the Stone Town waterfront.
data.address_line: Shangani, a 10-minute walk from Forodhani Gardens
data.description:
A cool, airy two bedroom house with high ceilings, tall shuttered windows and a shaded garden, a short walk from the Stone Town waterfront. It is partly furnished with beds, wardrobes and a dining set. Ceiling fans keep the rooms comfortable through the warm months.

The neighbourhood is quiet and walkable, with cafés, markets and the ferry terminal close by. Electricity is on a prepaid ZECO meter and water comes from ZAWA with a storage tank.

data.title: Modern 3 Bedroom Townhouse
data.summary: Three-storey townhouse with a rooftop terrace in a small gated estate, currently reserved.
data.description:
A contemporary three-storey townhouse in a small gated estate. The ground floor has the sitting room and fitted kitchen, with three en-suite bedrooms above and a rooftop terrace for evenings. Bedrooms have air conditioning.

The estate has a 24-hour guard and a generator for the common areas. This townhouse is currently reserved by another tenant. You can still contact the agent to join the waiting list in case it becomes available again.
